hints.title: Individual Sum vs Bundle
hints.text: Calculate the sum of individual purchase costs for all required items.

hints.title: Compare with Bundle Offer
hints.text: If buying the bundle costs less than purchasing all items individually, purchasing the bundle is optimal.

hints.title: Return Minimum
hints.text: The minimum cost to acquire all items is min(sum(individual), bundle_cost).

hints.title: Complete Implementation

complexity.whyNaiveFails: Overcomplicating bundle combinations when only one global bundle is offered.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Expects clean comparison between individual sum and bundle cost.
